constraints.name: bitacora_newcentury_required_or_two_oct_2026_historical
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((time_start IS NOT NULL) AND (time_end IS NOT NULL) AND (km_initial IS NOT NULL) AND (km_final IS NOT NULL) AND (km_travel IS NOT NULL) AND (odometer_start_path IS NOT NULL) AND (odometer_end_path IS NOT NULL)) OR ((employee_id = 'NEW-c99ac78a86f14357a7718b712d92214c'::text) AND (((id = 'cb335120-4bbe-4c13-b150-837657652d48'::uuid) AND (date = '2026-10-01'::date)) OR ((id = '408597a9-bd25-4eef-8a7c-e01a42307e71'::uuid) AND (date = '2026-10-10'::date))) AND (origin = 'Bolonia'::text) AND (destination = 'Blok on Mateare'::text) AND (order_reference = 'EXCEPCION_HISTORICA_20261012'::text)) OR ((employee_id = 'NEW-bfafaa9052864ce9b55f0a72cce59fc4'::text) AND (vehicle_id = 'VEH-bfafaa9052864ce9b55f0a72cce59fc4'::text) AND (order_reference = 'EXCEPCION_HISTORICA_ANDREW_20261014'::text) AND (km_travel = (km_final - km_initial)) AND ((km_traccar IS NULL) OR (km_traccar = km_travel)) AND ((difference_km IS NULL) OR (difference_km = (0)::numeric)) AND (employee_observation IS NULL) AND ((((((((date = '2026-09-29'::date) AND (km_initial = (34066)::numeric) AND (km_final = (34084)::numeric)) OR ((date = '2026-09-29'::date) AND (km_initial = (34084)::numeric) AND (km_final = (34100)::numeric))) OR ((date = '2026-09-30'::date) AND (km_initial = (34100)::numeric) AND (km_final = (34118)::numeric))) OR ((date = '2026-09-30'::date) AND (km_initial = (34118)::numeric) AND (km_final = (34134)::numeric))) OR ((date = '2026-10-01'::date) AND (km_initial = (34134)::numeric) AND (km_final = (34152)::numeric))) OR ((date = '2026-10-01'::date) AND (km_initial = (34152)::numeric) AND (km_final = (34168)::numeric))) OR ((date = '2026-10-02'::date) AND (km_initial = (34168)::numeric) AND (km_final = (34186)::numeric))))))
